title: Modified Behavioral Test for Alcohol Drinking and Social Interaction in Mice
author: Su, He, et al.
materials: A behavior analysis system purchased from Shanghai Jiliang Software Technology Company was used for video tracking and analysis. This video analysis system employs grayscale analysis to identify the movement of mice, with experimental parameters including recognition range and threshold being set. In this experiment, the recognition range was set to be greater than or equal to 50 pixels, while the threshold range was set between 25 and 75. In different laboratory environments, this parameter can be adjusted appropriately to achieve better recognition results. Social behaviors analysis includes distances, movement durations, and contacting times and durations [5]. Behavior was defined as social interaction when the head of the experimental mice was facing the social mice and the distance was not greater than 1 cm [4].

steps.title: Acclimate stimulus mice in room
steps.instruction: Place the novel (social stimulus) mice in the testing room, still in their homecage, and allow them to acclimate for 1 hour.

steps.title: Acclimate stimulus mice in apparatus
steps.instruction: After the 1‑hour room acclimation, transfer the same novel mice into the cylindrical test cage and let them acclimate for 10 minutes. Observe for disruptive behaviors (bar‑biting, excessive self‑grooming, circling, clinging to sidebars with all four paws); if any abnormal behavior is seen after the 10‑minute period, exclude that mouse from the experiment.

steps.title: Record and analyze mouse behavior
steps.instruction: Video‑record the general behaviors of both experimental and stimulus mice, then analyze the recordings with the designated software, ensuring that stimulus mice display normal behavior before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Analyze recordings with the behavior analysis software
Confirm that stimulus mice behave normally

steps.title: Configure behavior analysis software
steps.instruction: Set up the behavior analysis system (Shanghai Jiliang Software Technology). Configure video‑tracking parameters: recognition range ≥ 50 pixels and threshold range 25–75. Adjust these settings as needed for the laboratory environment. Define social interaction as the experimental mouse’s head facing the stimulus mouse at a distance ≤ 1 cm. The software will output distances, movement durations, and contact times/durations.
